newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fuji, Apple may tie up in imaging business - paper.
newsitem.headline: Fuji, Apple may tie up in imaging business - paper.

text.p: Fuji Photo Film Co Ltd and Apple Computer Inc may form an alliance in the area of imaging products and software, the Japanese business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Monday.

The paper said that Fuji Photo, which had already agreed to supply Apple with digital cameras for sale under the Apple brand name, would further expand its alliance with the U.S.-based personal computer manufacturer.
A Fuji Photo spokesman on Monday confirmed that the two companies had already agreed on the supply of digital cameras but said no decision had been made on any further areas of cooperation.
"Nothing (other than the supply of digital cameras) has been decided," the spokesman said.
He added, however, that Fuji Photo has said it may seek alliances with other companies in the imaging business.
